## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Build`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `build-configurations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Build**.

## Step 2: Configure build settings

1. In the left navigation, select **Build**.
2. <!-- manual: In the top-right corner of the Builds card, click the settings icon. The Build Configurations panel opens on the right. -->
3. <!-- manual: Configure the following settings: -->
4. Select **Save**.
